title: Level 3 Object Facet Contract
purpose: Give centered House inhabitants enough internal structure to be meaningfully inspected without promoting every object into a full crystallized entity dossier.
relationship_to_entity_dossier: This is the lightweight Level-3 projection of data/house/entity-dossier-schema.json. Mature real-world institutions can later upgrade to the full dossier contract while retaining the same object ID.

identity.question: What is this object in ordinary factual/project terms?

timeline.question: What dated sequence matters for understanding it?

sources.question: What source-bearing records support or define it?

flows.question: What moves through or around it?

status.question: What is established, attributed, disputed, unresolved or project-native?

consequences.question: What documented outputs, effects, harms or capabilities follow?

questions.question: What would materially deepen, challenge or falsify the current understanding?

repair.question: What correction, redesign, exit or next-step pathway exists?

display_rules: Status and source facets remain visible for sensitive real-world cases.
Relationships are typed connections, not guilt by association.
Flows distinguish money, attention, information, authority, material and people rather than collapsing them into one River.
Questions remain questions; they are not converted into implied allegations.
A lightweight object may have only identity + sources + questions.
A mature real-world institution should upgrade to the full entity-dossier schema rather than indefinitely expanding this lightweight projection.
